purpose: Computes perp liquidation price, margin health, buffer, and distance to liquidation for isolated and cross-margin modes. Covers Hyperliquid, dYdX v4, Binance, GMX, and generic venues. Includes portfolio-margin spot-offset and cross-margin efficiency calculation. Not financial advice.
